summary: A1 triage of the nineteen AFG-sourced anchors sitting on filler / anime-only-canon One Piece rows. Eighteen are JUNK ANCHORS and one (ep 737) is a WRONG ROW TYPE. The systematic cause is visible in the source itself: AFG's chapter column is a reading-position conversion, so on a noncanon row it simply plateaus at the last adapted chapter - eps 214 and 216 both print 313 while AFG marks them *Filler in the same row, eps 50/51 both print 98, eps 497/498 both print 585. Ten of the eighteen do carry a real sliver, and onepiece.fandom pins most of them to the page: ep 203 = ch 303 p.16-18, ep 326 = ch 442 p.2-3, ep 418 = ch 523 p.14-17, ep 419 = ch 523 p.18-19 + ch 524 p.8-9, 13-14, ep 626 = ch 699 p.14-15, ep 747 = ch 802 p.3-5, plus ep 55's grafted Calm Belt scene from ch 101 (Apis substituted for Usopp), ep 98's cactus-juice hallucination from ch 162, ep 93's provisioning beat from ch 158 and ep 50/51's single ch 98 shopping panel - all at or near the <=~5-page line, so they become annotation facts, not anchors. Ep 455 is the worst of the nineteen: it animates only the Straw Hat's Separation Serial COVER pages of chapters 545/546/550/551 while the mainline sits at ch 549, so its stored END of 551 pushed a reader two chapters past what they had seen. Eps 50 and 51 turn out to adapt the 2000 Loguetown light novel (Acts 3 and 4) rather than the manga at all. Ep 737 is the genuine mistype: chapter 794 'Sabo's Adventure' is precisely this episode plus ep 738, the wiki cites ch 794 as ep=737|ep2=738, AFG lists it as unmarked canon, and Oda co-wrote the script - anime-only-canon -> mixed, anchor unchanged.

Both were skipped in the remastered edition.

type_corrections.note: WRONG ROW TYPE, the one of the nineteen. Stored anime-only-canon (AFL's anime_canon), but the episode genuinely adapts chapter 794: onepiece.fandom's Dressrosa Arc narrative cites ch 794 as ep=737|ep2=738, ch 794's page summary is this episode's plot, and the Episode 737 page's Anime Notes are an explicit anime-vs-manga differences list ('In the manga, Law first revealed that he took Bellamy with them...; the manga never showed who chained Cavendish; The anime adds the following...') plus the note that 'although a large portion of the episode contains filler material, Eiichiro Oda worked with the anime studio on the episode's script'. AFG lists ch 794 for ep 737 with no *Filler or *Mixed marker, i.e. fully watchable canon, while marking eps 748-750 of the same stretch *Filler. Manga base plus heavy Oda-supervised expansion = mixed. This type must be pinned at the manual tier or an AFL-derived re-type will restore anime-only-canon.

structure.notes: Systematic finding: all nineteen anchors came from animefillerguide, whose 'Chapters' column is a reading-position conversion ('One Piece Filler List & Episode to Chapter Conversion Guide'), not an adaptation claim. On a filler or anime-only row it plateaus at the last adapted chapter, which is exactly the shape seen here - ep 214 and ep 216 both print 313 while AFG simultaneously marks them *Filler, eps 50/51 both print 98, eps 497/498 both print 585. Every one of these nineteen rows is bracketed by real anchors on canon neighbours, so nulling opens no coverage hole: 48/52 around 50-51, 53/61 around 55, 92/94 around 93, 97/100 around 98, 195/207 around 203, 212/217 around 214-216, 316/320 around 319, 325/337 around 326, 417/421 around 418-420, 452/459 around 455, 496/500 around 497-498, 625/628 around 626, 746/751 around 747. Numbering identity is not in doubt: our episode numbers, titles and air dates match onepiece.fandom's Episode Box '#' field and AFL's list one-for-one on all nineteen rows (the series has a single continuous 1-1175 numbering with no season restarts), so the context file's open flag #818 about title drift does not affect this set. Chapter space is mainline One Piece numbering throughout; ep 455's four citations are cover pages of mainline chapters, labelled as such rather than converted. Useful source discovery for future One Piece work: onepiece.fandom's ARC pages carry {{Qref|chap=N|page=X-Y|ep=Z}} citations inline in the narrative - a page-level chapter-to-episode map maintained separately from the episode infoboxes, and the only source that resolved eps 214/216 (ch 313 p.2-7 -> 212, p.8-9 -> 215, p.11-19 -> 217) and ep 203.

flags_for_sean: Sibling inconsistency in the 'Straw Hats' Whereabouts' block: eps 418-420 are typed anime-only-canon (this task) but ep 421 is typed mixed and keeps its ch 524 anchor. All four are the same thing - anime-original expansions of the ch 523-524 landing panels - and the split comes straight from AFL, which types 418-420 anime_canon and 421 mixed. Ep 421 is out of this task's scope; it is also the one the wiki page-cites most (ch 524 p.10-12, p.16, p.18-19), so keeping its anchor is defensible, but the four should be ruled on as a block.

The anime version also diverges from the manga - Chopper is not recovered and Robin is lost to Foxy - which reads as filler rather than anime-only-canon. Recommend retyping 213-216 as a block if Sean agrees, rather than 214/216 alone.
